standard_prerequisites.name: The limit of a diagram of sheaves of sets is a sheaf; left adjoints preserve colimits
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Sites, Lemma sites-lemma-limit-sheaf (tag 00W1); Categories, Lemma categories-lemma-adjoint-exact (tag 0036)
standard_prerequisites.use: Justify that the presheaf limit is a sheaf and that sheafification computes the colimit, hence exactness for filtered colimits.

core_obligations: Recall from the presheaf case that limits and colimits of abelian presheaves exist and are computed sectionwise (proof lines 439-441).

Limits: for a diagram of sheaves, form its limit as a diagram of abelian presheaves and use the limit-sheaf lemma to see that this presheaf is a sheaf; conclude that it is the limit in abelian sheaves and that limits commute with sections (proof lines 443-448).

Colimits: use that sheafification is left adjoint to the inclusion and that the inclusion is exact to conclude that the colimit exists and is the sheafification of the presheaf colimit, giving (4) (proof lines 450-454).
Deduce the remaining statements: agreement of finite direct sums with the presheaf ones and exactness of filtered colimits, completing the proof up to line 474.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the presheaf descriptions already available.
Get limits by noticing that the presheaf limit is a sheaf.
Get colimits by adjointness of sheafification, then filtered exactness.
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes five facts about limits and colimits in the category of abelian sheaves on a site: existence of all limits and colimits, agreement of limits with presheaf limits, agreement of finite direct sums with the presheaf ones, the description of colimits as sheafified presheaf colimits, and exactness of filtered colimits. Limits are handled by taking the presheaf limit and using that it is already a sheaf, whence it is also the sheaf-theoretic limit; colimits are handled by adjointness of sheafification with the inclusion, which identifies the colimit as a sheafified presheaf colimit and gives exactness of filtered colimits (proof lines 438-474). H2: the two identifications through the sheaf condition and through adjointness are the substance, and the argument is written out rather than cited wholesale.
